capabilities.label: Exact published Pixel model/codename identity
capabilities.detail: Matches only the published Pixel Tensor model names or codenames listed by AOSP and records the running build and slot evidence.

capabilities.label: Published Pixel kernel compatibility context
capabilities.detail: Explains published GKI branch and vendor-ramdisk boundaries; ROMVERSE does not infer the currently installed firmware/kernel pairing from a model name alone.

capabilities.label: Pixel firmware operations
capabilities.detail: No build, unlock, flash, rollback, slot change, or recovery operation is enabled without a separate exact firmware hash and physical recovery contract.

notes: The exact model/codename match improves offline diagnosis but does not identify region, carrier, current build, bootloader revision, or rollback index.
Google warns that factory-image installation erases data and that release-specific anti-rollback notices can apply; Guardian keeps device-changing execution locked.
